name: Unlimited Raising Cane's
description: 🍗 UNLIMITED CANE’S 🍗 You read that right. Unlimited. Cane’s. Come to Beta and eat an unreasonable amount of chicken fingers, fries, Texas toast, and the greatest sauce known to mankind. We’ll keep the Cane’s coming until you physically cannot eat another tender. Pull up hungry, tour the house, meet the brothers, and hang out over way too much Cane’s. Bring an appetite. We’ll bring the chicken. 🍗🔥
dates: Saturday, September 05 from 02:00 PM to 04:00 PM

name: The Great Beta Fiesta
description: 🌮 THE GREAT BETA FIESTA 🎺 Tacos. MARIACHI!!! Beta. What more do you need? Come by the house for a loaded taco bar, live mariachi music, and a night of hanging out with the brothers. Grab a plate, check out the house, and stick around for the fiesta. 🌮🎺
dates: Saturday, September 05 from 05:00 PM to 08:00 PM

name: MIT Family Feud
description: 🎤 FAMILY FEUD 🎤 Survey says… Beta’s running Family Feud. Grab a team, talk some trash, and go head-to-head answering questions about MIT, college life, and a few things you definitely won’t see coming. 😂🔥
dates: Saturday, September 05 from 08:00 PM to 11:00 PM

name: Endless Milkshakes & Gatas
description: Join us for blood-pumping games of ping pong or Gatas (AKA Crud, a much-loved MIT student pastime) right in the center of our first floor lobby! Fuel your fun with all-you-can-drink from 2^20 different milkshake combos in our enormous dessert bar! Thick, creamy, and wonderfully caloric! Available every night! Options available for all dietary restrictions
dates: Saturday, September 05 from 08:00 PM to 12:00 AM

name: Doomscrolling on an Actual 4-Story Screen
description: Is bigger better? Does size matter? Come find out at Beta, home to the biggest screen at MIT! Play Tetris on an actual building, watch YouTube, or broadcast other questionable animations to the whole block, you decide!

name: Beta Video Game Night
description: Enjoy some quality gaming time from a huge selection of games on our Switch and PS5. We also have tabletop games like Risk and Zombicide! Challenge others to smash, stick fight, or sit back and watch the mayhem unfold in both of our TV gaming areas!

name: Morning Spikeball & Donut Holes
description: 🤾 SPIKEBALL & DONUT HOLES 🍩 Start your morning at Kresge Oval with some Spikeball, donut holes, and a laid-back hangout with Beta. Jump into a game, grab some food, and meet some of the brothers.
dates: Sunday, September 06 from 10:00 AM to 11:00 AM
Monday, September 07 from 11:00 AM to 12:00 PM
Tuesday, September 08 from 11:00 AM to 12:00 PM

name: All You Can Eat American Grill & Stir Fry
description: 🔥 FIRE + ICE 🧊 Feast on endless possibilities at FiRE+iCE, a beloved MIT hotspot! Dive into an AYCE American grill and stir-fry buffet where you create your experience. Whether you crave a smoky BBQ flavor or a zesty stir-fry, you can mix, match, and craft your culinary masterpiece! Options available for all dietary restrictions.
dates: Sunday, September 06 from 11:30 AM to 01:30 PM

name: Paintball Warfare Showdown
description: 🎯 PAINTBALL 🔫 You've just been drafted into war, and the ongoing campaign, Operation Beta Thunder. If you’ve ever wanted to shoot frat bros (but not lethally of course…) this is your chance! We’ll split into teams, play a bunch of rounds, talk some trash, and find out who can actually aim and who’s been training with the Stormtroopers.
dates: Sunday, September 06 from 02:00 PM to 06:00 PM

name: Late-Night Chinatown Meal
description: 🥟 CHINATOWN 🧋 Still hungry? So are we! Head into Chinatown with Beta and eat your way around the neighborhood. Grab some dumplings, noodles, boba, and whatever else looks good, then hang out and explore with the brothers.
dates: Sunday, September 06 from 07:30 PM to 11:00 PM

name: All You Can Eat Sushi Buffet
description: 🍣 YAMATO II 🍣 Come out with Beta for all-you-can-eat sushi at Yamato II. Order way too many rolls, try something new, and hang out with the brothers over an endless stream of sushi. 🍱
dates: Monday, September 07 from 12:30 PM to 02:00 PM

name: Real-Life Video Game Arena (Level 99)
description: 🎮 LEVEL 99 🧩 Come out with Beta to Level 99 and take on a bunch of ridiculous challenges with a team. Race through rooms, solve puzzles, climb stuff, and compete your way through as many challenges as you can. 😤
dates: Monday, September 07 from 03:00 PM to 07:00 PM

name: Build Your Own Bluetooth Speaker
description: 🔊 DIY SPEAKERS 🛠️ Come build your own working speaker with Beta and make it your own. We’ll have everything you need to put it together, customize it, and actually take it home when you’re done. No experience needed, just show up and build something cool.
dates: Monday, September 07 from 07:30 PM to 10:00 PM

name: Eat Big in Little Italy
description: 🍝 EAT BIG IN LITTLE ITALY 🦐 Head into Boston’s North End with Beta and explore Little Italy. Grab some pasta, pastries, gelato, or whatever catches your eye, and hang out with the brothers while we make our way around the neighborhood. 🍨
dates: Tuesday, September 08 from 12:30 PM to 03:00 PM

name: Canoeing Up the Charles River
description: 🛶 CANOEING UP THE CHARLES WITH BETA 🌊 Get out on the Charles with Beta for an afternoon of canoeing and kayaking. Paddle around, enjoy the view, and hang out with the brothers out on the water.
dates: Tuesday, September 08 from 03:00 PM to 07:00 PM

name: Build Your Own Pizzas & Donuts
description: 🍕 MAKE YOUR OWN PIZZA & DONUTS 🍩 Come hang out with Beta and make your own personal pizza from scratch. Load it up however you want, throw it in the oven, then finish things off by making and decorating donuts with the brothers.
dates: Tuesday, September 08 from 08:00 PM to 11:00 PM

name: MIT Lecture Hall Karaoke Pizza Party
description: 🎤 LECTURE HALL KARAOKE PIZZA PARTY 🎶 Had a long FDOC? Grab the mic and come sing with Beta at our Klassroom Karaoke Pizza Party. Pick your song, get your friends up there with you, and spend the night yelling your favorite songs with the brothers.
dates: Wednesday, September 09 from 05:00 PM to 06:30 PM

name: Glizzy Guzzling Gauntlet
description: 🌭 GLIZZY GUZZLING GAUNTLET 🌭 Think you can put down some hot dogs? Come to Beta for the Glizzy Guzzling Gauntlet and go head-to-head with the brothers in a full-on hot dog eating contest. Bring an appetite, bring some confidence, and see how far you make it.
dates: Wednesday, September 09 from 07:00 PM to 09:00 PM

name: Froyo, Burritos, & Taco Bowl Food Crawl
description: 🌯 472 + EL JEFE’S 🌯 Start the night hanging out with Beta at Cafe 472 for some froyo, then head over to El Jefe’s for some late-night Mexican food. Good people, good food, and an easy way to end the night.
dates: Thursday, September 10 from 05:00 PM to 08:00 PM

name: Bob Ross and Charcuterie Night
description: 🎨 BOB ROSS & CHARCUTERIE 🧀 Come paint with Beta while following along with a Bob Ross tutorial and snacking on a full charcuterie spread. No painting experience needed, just grab a brush, make some happy little trees, and hang out with the brothers.
dates: Thursday, September 10 from 08:00 PM to 11:00 PM

name: Bouldering & Climbing Night with Beta
description: 🧗 BOULDERING WITH BETA 🧗 Come bouldering with Beta and spend the afternoon climbing with the brothers. Whether you’ve been climbing for years or have never touched a wall, hop on some routes, try something new, and hang out between climbs.
dates: Friday, September 11 from 05:00 PM to 08:00 PM

name: Beta Grill & Chill
description: Take a break from building and get a tour of our historic 5 story brownstone mansion featuring a beautiful library study space, fully stocked industrial kitchen, eletrical engineering and mechanical engineering machine shops, and newly renovated basement lounge/game room while feasting on delicious hamburgers fresh off the grill. Stop by for a burger, a quick chat, and chill vibes! Options available for all dietary restrictions.
dates: Friday, September 11 from 08:00 PM to 12:00 AM

name: Kings Bowling (Invite Only)
description: 🎳 KINGS BOWLING (INVITE ONLY) 🎳 Join Beta for a night of bowling, food, and hanging out at Kings. Grab a lane, talk some trash, and spend the night with the brothers. Invite Only Event
dates: Saturday, September 12 from 04:00 PM to 07:00 PM
